analysis.why: delta +0.3125 clears the measured noise floor 0.1250 but falls short of the 0.3750 required at k=1 calibration run(s) (identical code in both arms). The sign-flip p is not wrong about the signs; it cannot know this score is coarse enough that identical code has already produced a delta this big. Add pairs, or add A/A runs to tighten the floor.
